title: Egyptian Lamb Shawarma
description: A flavorful and aromatic lamb dish inspired by Egyptian street food, perfect for a quick and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: Boneless and cut into thin strips

ingredients.name: Egyptian spices
ingredients.notes: A blend of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and cardamom

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, Egyptian spices, and a pinch of salt. Add the lamb strips and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the lamb strips onto skewers, if using.
Grill the lamb for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for a few minutes.
Caramelize the onions by cooking them in a pan with a little oil over low heat for 20-25 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by slicing the grilled lamb into thin strips and serving it in the warm pita breads with caramelized onions, diced tomatoes, sliced cucumbers, and pickles.
